name: Aldaren
title: The Evenking
examine: The first of the few: old blood, whole, and older than the word for it. He opened the gate after a hundred and fifty years, and he carries the cost of every quiet year like a coat.
lines: You came up the Evenway. I planted the third stone on it. Or the fourth... no. The third.
The gate is open because family was knocking. The thinned blood is still the blood.
The foreman's grandchildren wear a crown now. He would have laughed. He had a good laugh.
